items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: he helped me a lot in music... he taught me a whole lot about harmony

ctx.x: Right. I'm thinking people who were older.

Uh, Clemett Turballon, did you know him? Sure. He was there. And, uh, now that was a guy who helped me a lot in music, because we were in the Navy together, in the same band. Oh, Clemett Turballon? Yeah. And he had been playing with Joe Robichaud's big band, and he played with, he played with, oh, a couple of other bands that traveled. Then he played, he did a lot of playing, but he never studied. He just was a gifted musician. And he taught me a whole lot about harmony. And when I, and then I learned from that,…
What year were you at Xavier?
